label: Member not found
description: The service does not recognise the member. This is a finding about the test data, not about the environment. CRD 2.0.1 has no code for this.
basis: Synthetic. CRD 2.0.1 defines no body for a failed call, so this models a FHIR OperationOutcome. It has not been observed from the live service.
assumption: How the live service signals an unknown member is not known. This file models an HTTP 404 carrying a FHIR OperationOutcome whose issue code is not-found and whose expression names the Patient.

details.text: No member matches the identifier supplied.

issue.diagnostics: No member matches the identifier supplied.
